cases.explain: «следующие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

cases.sentence: Старейшины со ___, которые жили в городе Навота, сделали так, как приказала им в письмах Иезавель.
cases.explain: «знатными людьми» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

cases.sentence: Я истреблю твоих потомков и искореню у Ахава всякого человека ___ — и раба, и свободного.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
